cause.summary: Revision-1 answers failed deterministic AA-P8/1.0 rules that study_forensics_prompt/v3-phase8 never stated or stated differently (65 unstated, 5 ambiguous, 9 implied, 7 stated of 86).

correction.kind: prompt contract disclosure + profile revision; validator unchanged

claude-haiku-5-5@2.rationale: R1: binds the explicitly stated AA-P8/1.0 host contract prompt. max_tokens 16000 -> 32000 because @1 used up to 15505 of 16000 output tokens (LS-04) and the stated contract asks for more trace objects; the documented synchronous maximum is 128K. Effort and thinking unchanged.

claude-sonnet-5-5@2.rationale: R1: binds the explicitly stated AA-P8/1.0 host contract prompt. All request parameters equal @1, which used at most 8168 of 16000 output tokens; effort medium kept.

call_plan.primary: the same 6 frozen cases with claude-haiku-5-5@2, then with claude-sonnet-5-5@2, each exactly once via `agent-arena audit run --live`
call_plan.checkpoint: after the 6 Haiku runs the stored answers are analysed offline; Sonnet runs only if no new technical defect requires repair cycle R2
call_plan.phase9: counterreview only on REVIEW_RECOMMENDED, stability only after a completed counterreview on a mandatory, technically complete case; at most one each per case and model
call_plan.technical_retries: at most one per failed request, separately reserved

preregistration.order: Haiku @2 LS-01..LS-06, then Sonnet @2 LS-01..LS-06; fixed, no reordering
preregistration.stop_rule: A slot refused by authorization, budget, ceiling or attempt checks is reported as not run; no reallocation, no reordering, no replacement slot.
preregistration.cycle_boundary: The Haiku and Sonnet halves form one cycle R1; any code, prompt or profile change between them is repair cycle R2 and is reported as such.
preregistration.c25_rule: An asserted_state that differs from the host-derived state (contract rule C25) is an output-audit finding of the model output, reported under extraction/output quality; it is not a technical defect and cannot by itself justify repair cycle R2. The scientific state derivation is deliberately not disclosed; only bookkeeping (C29) is.
preregistration.r2_rule: R2 only for a newly found technical defect (transport, adapter, parser, budget binding or an incorrect contract statement): cause named, minimal correction tested offline, critic check, then only the affected technical path re-run live if necessary and affordable.
preregistration.phase9: natural triggers only; not triggered paths stay not_exercised

offline_test_of_correction.summary: Critic simulation on the 12 stored revision-1 answers (not model output), run against the pre-correction R1 text (rules C1-C28 before critic round 1): literal C1-C28 copy repairs 0/12 strict passes, +C12/C14 2/12; remaining failures are C25 state mismatches; an oracle with host-derived states (not a permitted repair) reaches 11/12.

reporting: Revision 1 (@1) and R1 (@2) results are reported separately; no merged success rate.
release_policy: Only clearly labelled test-only local releases for READY_FOR_RELEASE bundles; no human adjudication or signature is created; required human decisions stay open.
